final.memo:
The Company represents a classic conglomerate discount case where a high-quality, 43% margin commercial information franchise is obscured by a founder-led residential expansion consuming significant capital [D01, D02]. While the company generated 11% revenue growth in 2025, the consolidated operating margin remains a paltry 0.17%, a stark contrast to peers like MSCI which command 53.5% margins [D02, D06, D07]. The market currently misprices this business as a unified growth-at-any-cost entity, ignoring the hidden earnings power of the commercial core [D05].

Our sum-of-the-parts analysis values the commercial business at ~20x-25x earnings, which, when combined with our $3.689 billion net cash position, implies a fundamental value of $125 per share [D02, D03, D04, D06]. With the stock trading at $79.23, the residential segment is currently valued at essentially zero, providing us a free option on its long-term viability [D04]. This setup offers a compelling 58% upside with a hard floor at $75, protected by the company's robust balance sheet [D02, D04].

Our plan is straightforward: we are initiating private dialogue with the Board to demand immediate cessation of excessive residential spending and an acceleration of capital returns beyond the current $500 million authorization [D02, D07]. We expect the board to implement stricter oversight of capital allocation to prioritize profitable growth over vanity scale [D07]. We have given this a two-quarter timetable for engagement before considering more public measures, including potential board nominations [D07].

We are sizing this at 5% of NAV, reflecting our high conviction in the asset quality and the significant margin of safety provided by the net cash [D02, D04]. We will hedge the exposure with index puts to mitigate systemic real estate and tech beta, remaining focused on the idiosyncratic unlock of the core business [D05]. We will exit if management doubles down on value-destructive spending or if the commercial franchise shows signs of fundamental erosion [D07].
